You are allowed to import other python modules or numpy. # Action / Return Format - Return a tuple `(action, memory)` where `memory` is a dictionary that you will receive next call. - `action` is a move string that is an element of `legal_moves`. - Do not return any extra text, commentary, or formatting—only the move string. - The move strings is a UCI move string and almost always 4 characters long. Examples: `'b4b5', 'g3e1', etc. Castling is simply represented as a king move (e1g1, e1c1, e8g8, e8c8) - The only time the move strings is longer than 4 characters is when a pawn promotion is involved.
